title: Benny and the Missing Honey
moral: It’s important to be honest and ask before taking, and working together can fix mistakes.

scenes.summary: Benny the bear loves honey and shares a friendly relationship with the bees.
scenes.text:
Benny the Bear and the Missing Honey

In a cozy forest filled with tall trees and buzzing bees, lived a little bear named Benny.

Benny loved honey more than anything in the world.

Golden, sticky, sweet honey—yum!

Every morning, Benny would visit his favorite beehive and say,

“Good morning, bees! May I have some honey, please?”

The bees liked Benny because he was polite.

“Of course, Benny,” they buzzed. “Just a little!”

And Benny always took only what he needed.
scenes.image_prompt: cute bear asking bees for honey near a beehive in a colorful forest, friendly cartoon style

scenes.summary: Benny discovers the honey is missing and decides to solve the mystery.
scenes.text:
One morning, Benny walked to the beehive with a happy smile.

But when he looked inside…

It was empty.

“Empty?” Benny gasped. “Where did all the honey go?”

The bees were buzzing around nervously.

“We don’t know!” said one bee.

“It was here yesterday!” said another.

Benny scratched his head.

“This is a mystery,” he said.
scenes.image_prompt: surprised bear looking into empty beehive while worried bees buzz around, bright forest cartoon

scenes.summary: Benny follows sticky footprints through the forest to find clues.
scenes.text:
“I will find the missing honey!” Benny declared.

He put on a leaf like a detective hat.

“First, I need clues,” he said.

He looked around the ground.

Hmm…

Sticky footprints!

“Someone walked here… and took the honey!” Benny said.

He followed the footprints through the forest.

The footprints led past the river…

Over some rocks…

And finally to a bush.

Benny peeked behind it.
scenes.image_prompt: bear detective wearing leaf hat following sticky footprints through forest, playful cartoon style

scenes.summary: Benny finds Ricky the Raccoon who admits taking the honey and feels sorry.
scenes.text:
And there he saw—

Ricky the Raccoon, licking his paws.

“Honey!” Ricky said happily.

“Ricky!” Benny said. “Did you take the honey from the bees?”

Ricky looked surprised.

“Um… maybe just a little,” he said.

Benny pointed at the empty pot beside him.

“That’s not a little.”

Ricky looked down.

“I was very hungry,” he said softly.

Benny thought for a moment.

“The bees worked very hard for that honey,” he said gently.

Ricky nodded. “I know… I’m sorry.”

“Let’s fix this,” Benny said.

Together, they went back to the beehive.

Ricky said, “I’m sorry, bees. I took your honey without asking.”

The bees buzzed quietly.

“That was not right,” they said.

“I will help you make more honey,” Ricky added.

The bees smiled.

“That would be wonderful!”
scenes.image_prompt: raccoon caught eating honey while bear talks kindly, bees nearby, colorful jungle cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Ricky helps the bees, the hive is restored, and everyone shares happily.
scenes.text:
For the next few days, Ricky helped the bees find flowers.

Benny helped too!

They gathered nectar, protected the hive, and worked as a team.

Soon, the beehive was full again.

Golden honey dripped from the comb.

The bees shared honey with Benny—and even with Ricky!

“Thank you for helping,” they said.

Ricky smiled.

“Next time, I’ll ask first.”

Benny laughed.

“And maybe take just a little!”

Everyone giggled.

It’s important to be honest and ask before taking.

And working together can fix mistakes.

The End
